label: Inlet from last manhole
detail: Raw sewage enters through the higher of the two pipes (100 mm on the PE series, 150 mm on the FRP series) and is turned down into the settling zone.

label: Primary settling zone
detail: Flow travels down the outer zone, where solids settle, then passes under the filter chamber; settled sludge is removed once every two years.

label: Bio-media filter
detail: Settled water rises through plastic bio-media held between a top and a bottom plate; the media strains out fine particles and dissolved matter (upflow anaerobic filtration).

label: Outlet to public drain
detail: Filtered effluent leaves by the lower pipe for discharge to a public drain; inlet and outlet invert levels are to be confirmed per site.

label: Top water level (TWL)
detail: Water stands at height H2 above the tank base, given per model in the specification schedule.

label: Manhole access
detail: Covers sit at ground level on brick sump extensions through a 100 mm slab; the smaller opening gives isolated, direct access to the settling zone for de-sludging.

label: Base and sand backfill
detail: The tank sits on a 150 mm Grade 30 concrete base with BRC-A9 mesh over 50 mm lean concrete, backfilled with sand compacted in 150 mm layers.
